title: Kross Limited (NSE: KROSS) — Institutional Underwriting Dossier & Stage 2 Playbook
holding_rationale: Zerodha holds 424 shares of Kross Limited at a ₹273.05 average cost (₹1,15,773.60 total). At the 2026-11-23 NSE ledger close of ₹277.00, market value is ₹1,17,448.00 (+₹1,674.40, or +1.45%, at 2.75% weight). At the 2026-11-25 live TV close of ₹268.10, mark-to-market value is ₹1,13,674.40 (-1.81%). We retain all 424 shares (holding_shares_to_sell = 0) and ratchet the hard stop upward from ₹212.00 to ₹219.06. Price-blind Pass 1 underwriting keeps CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL (PASS_WITH_WATCH). H1 FY27 CFO fell to ₹4.73 Cr (14.3% of ₹33.16 Cr PAT), leaving -₹54.43 Cr H1 FCF. Gross debt is guided to ~₹165–170 Cr by March 2027, since Oct 30 brought only ₹39.75 Cr upfront across 6.75 Cr diluted shares. External sales from 1,20,000 TPA Mill 219 also face a 93%-share domestic oligopoly. Trimming Base Target from ₹400.00 to ₹360.00 (24.0x FY28E diluted EPS ₹14.96) yields 1.43:1 R:R at ₹277.00 NSE and 1.87:1 at ₹268.10 live TV. With 4H RSI weak at 35.22, new capital stays WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (TIER_3) in ₹234.00–₹252.00 (3.28:1 R:R from ₹252.00).

holding_alerts.instruction: Exit all 424 Zerodha shares on a confirmed daily close below ₹219.06 and pause new-capital entry.

holding_alerts.instruction: Commit new capital beyond the existing 424-share (2.75% wt) stake only inside ₹234.00–₹252.00 (3.28:1 R:R to ₹360.00 against ₹219.06 stop) if both 4H repair and Q3 cash-conversion or Mill 219 gates confirm.

destinations.entry_condition: Consider in a separate CORE_ALPHA allocation inside its ₹1,951.99–₹2,036.18 underwriting cap (below the ₹2,066.72 raw snapshot upper bound) above its ₹1,685.64 stop.

destinations.rationale: Jamna Auto (live 2026-11-25 TV close ₹135.95, 21.70x TTM P/E, 22.48% ROE, 0.01x D/E) is the cleaner CV peer. Kept at 0% here pending dedicated underwriting.
destinations.entry_condition: Evaluate JAMNAAUTO for independent underwriting while holding above its ₹127.27 Stage 2 invalidation stop.

primer: Kross Limited scaled trailer axles to 49% of Q2 FY27 sales (+79.6% YoY to ₹235.1 Cr), yet H1 FY27 CFO fell to ₹4.73 Cr (14.3% conversion; -₹54.43 Cr FCF). Gross debt is guided to ~₹165–170 Cr by March 2027, and external 1,20,000 TPA Mill 219 sales face a 93% domestic oligopoly. Zerodha holds 424 shares at ₹273.05 avg cost (2.75% weight; ₹277.00 on 2026-11-23 NSE, ₹268.10 on 2026-11-25 live TV). We hold all 424 shares (HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP) and ratchet the hard stop up from ₹212.00 to ₹219.06. We trim Base Target to ₹360.00 and keep new capital WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (TIER_3) in ₹234.00–₹252.00 (3.28:1 R:R).
